subject: Contract: Pioneer Therapies - Statement of Work & Terms
body:
From: Claire Miller <cmiller@pioneer-thera.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pioneer Therapies - SOW draft + liability questions

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We've reviewed the SOW and legal sent back a few redlines — the main asks are: lower the liability cap to $250k (our budget limitations), a mutual indemnity carve-out for IP claims, and a 12-month warranty window with specific uptime credits.

Attached is our consolidated redline (Pioneer_SOW_redline_v3.docx). Can Redwood accept? If not, what approvals will be needed and how long would those take? We are aiming to finalize procurement by end of next week.

Best,
Claire Miller\VP Purchasing\Pioneer Therapies

[attachment: Pioneer_SOW_redline_v3.docx (docx, 42KB)]

---

From: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Miller <cmiller@pioneer-thera.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pioneer Therapies - SOW draft + liability questions

Claire — thanks for the redline and the timeline. Looping in Legal (Laura) and Sales Ops (Vivek) to confirm where we can be flexible. High level note for context: Pioneer is requesting a materially lower liability cap and an indemnity expansion that could increase Redwood's exposure.

Quick question for you while we triage: is Pioneer asking for liability cap to be $250k for all claims, or limited to direct damages only? Also confirm whether the warranty credits requested are the standard service credits (percent credits on monthly invoices) or a cash rebate.

I'll follow up after I hear from Laura with the ask for executive approval if needed.

—Dylan\Account Executive, Redwood Inference\dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com\(415) 555-0198

---

From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pioneer Therapies - SOW draft + liability questions

Team — reviewed the redline. Summary of legal concerns:

- Liability cap: Pioneer proposes $250k across all claims. Our standard is a 12-month revenue cap or $1M, whichever is lower. $250k is below our threshold for commercial deals and increases risk profile substantially.
- Indemnity: They want mutual IP indemnity with broad third-party claim language and a requirement for Redwood to defend. We can consider mutual IP indemnity but must narrow to third-party IP claims and exclude derivative/contractual disputes.
- Warranty: 12-month warranty with credit structure they propose is non-standard (they request credits that escalate to 50% for repeated outages). We should stick to the standard SLA credit matrix; any deviation needs exec approval.

Given the requested variance from standard terms, this will require executive authorization (CRO + Legal + CEO/CFO sign-off on risk exceptions). I recommend the following path:
1) Sales to confirm revenue and strategic importance (Vivek).
2) If deal size and strategic rationale justify, submit to Deal Desk with calibrated mitigations (higher price, shorter warranty, explicit carve-outs).
3) Executive review — provide a one-page risk memo and proposed compensations (price uplift or liability carve-outs).

If Pioneer is target-close this week, we can prepare an expedited packet. Role assignments: Dylan — please send forecasted ARR/contract value and whether Pioneer is willing to accept price uplift or additional controls (SOC2 + restricted data handling). Vivek — can you provide business rationale / strategic priority? Marissa — FYI for approval chain and any discretionary discount levers.

-Laura
Laura Bennett\Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference\laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

---

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pioneer Therapies - SOW draft + liability questions

Folks — quick read: Pioneer is mid-market with pilot-to-production upside. Expected first-year contract value is $275k (subscription + onboarding). They are sensitive to cap due to procurement rules.

I propose two options to present to Pioneer:
1) Commercial compromise: cap = $500k + mutual IP indemnity limited to third-party claims; maintain standard SLA credits. To get there we ask for a 12% price premium or a 1-year minimum commitment and prepayment.
2) Conservative: keep standard Redwood terms (12m rev cap / $1M) but offer a 10% onboarding credit and prioritized support during onboarding.

If Legal signs off on wording limits, I'm comfortable escalating to Marissa and assigning the deal desk approval if she concurs. Dylan — please confirm whether Pioneer will accept either a price uplift or extended commitment.

—Vivek\VP Sales, Redwood Inference\vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

---

From: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Miller <cmiller@pioneer-thera.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pioneer Therapies - SOW draft + liability questions

Claire — thanks for the quick turnaround. Two clarifying items from Pioneer: the $250k cap requested is intended to cover all claims (not direct-only), and the warranty credits they want are invoice credits that escalate.

We reviewed internally and have two paths to propose (see Vivek's options below). Are you open to option 1 (cap = $500k + 12% price uplift or 12-month commitment)? If so, we can put together an approval packet this afternoon to request exec sign-off. If Pioneer cannot accept either, let us know and we'll follow the conservative route.

Appreciate the quick confirmation — we want to keep to your procurement timeline.

Best,
Dylan

---

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 17 May 2028 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pioneer Therapies - SOW draft + liability questions (Exec packet request)

Thanks team — I reviewed the summary and agree we need to escalate. Next steps from me:

1) Dylan — prepare a one-page risk memo (bullet points: ask, financials, proposed mitigations: price uplift or 1yr commitment, SOC2/HIPAA if needed).
2) Laura — please draft the redlined clause we would present for the $500k compromise (limit to third-party IP only, defense obligation limited to indemnified claims).
3) Vivek — confirm expected ARR (again) and strategic rationale (partner potential + expansion timeline).

I'll put this on the Deal Desk queue and will route to the Exec Approval slate — target response time is 24-36 hours once packet is submitted. If Pioneer needs faster confirmation, we can do a brief exec call.

Marissa Cole\Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference\marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
